title: M-Pocket
summary: A Mastodon client for Cardputer Zero.
description:
M-Pocket brings Mastodon to Cardputer Zero. Sign in by scanning a QR code with your phone, browse your home and local timelines, search posts, reply and boost. Includes content warnings, saved login, and light and dark purple themes.

Hardware-test beta: physical device testing is still required. Search availability depends on your server.
